title: Emmanuel (great bourdon of Notre-Dame de Paris)
status_note: The south tower was not damaged in the 2019 fire.

place.label: South tower, Notre-Dame de Paris
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

maker: 1686 casting: founders Chapelle, Gillot, Moreau and Le Guay
mass_note: 13,320 kg, bell alone (Ministry of Culture page)

timeline.event: The earlier bourdon Jacqueline is renamed Emmanuel
Hoisted into the south tower; found to be a semitone too low
Blessed; Louis XIV is its sponsor
Cathedral fire; the south tower and bourdon survive

tiers.everyday: Emmanuel is the biggest bell of Notre-Dame de Paris, recast in 1686 and weighing about 13 tonnes. It survived the 2019 fire in the south tower.
tiers.student: The Ministry of Culture page traces castings in 1680–1681, a bell hoisted in 1682 that sounded a semitone low, and a successful recasting on 4 March 1686, blessed on 29 April 1686. Present figures: 13,320 kg, diameter 261 cm. The cathedral calls it the great bourdon of the south tower.
